verdict.rationale: SerpApi publishes self-serve plan pricing with explicit search allotments, such as Free at $0 for 250 searches/month and Cloud 1M at $3,750/mo for 1,000,000 searches. It sells month-to-month with cancel-anytime terms, so contacting sales is optional (enterprise only), and it documents that cached searches are not billed. A community user independently cites Production at $150 for 15,000 searches/month. Missing for 10: an explicit per-request or overage rate (per-search cost must be derived from plan tiers), and the full tier table is not shown in the evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see clear per-request or per-credit pricing without talking to sales

citations.quote: Start for free, upgrade as you grow, or contact our team about an enterprise plan tailored to your volume, performance, and compliance needs.
Cached searches are free, and are not counted towards your searches per month.
